title: Siman 378
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.en: (40.) Regarding the writing of his holy books — many Torah discourses he himself wrote o.b.m., and some the friends wrote, and the rest I wrote. He said: "My language is close to the intended meaning." And my language was pleasing in his eyes. And he said I am next after him — meaning regarding the elegance of language of the Torah discourses: my language is much superior to all the others. Except that his own language is certainly better and superior beyond all — but after his language it is my language that is immediately of the next rank compared to the language of the other friends...
